summary.text: Rodney King, an independent who says he is a retired U.S. Navy submarine and nuclear weapons officer who now lives on a farm in Tennessee, lost the November 3, 2026 election for the U.S. House in Tennessee's 3rd District to Chuck Fleischmann.

paragraphs.text: Rodney King says he served in the U.S. Navy as a qualified submarine officer and nuclear weapons officer aboard the USS Nathan Hale (SSBN 623) from 1983 to 1986.
He then served on the Joint Strategic Target Planning Staff from 1986 to 1988 and finished his service as a reservist.
He says he and his wife live on a farm in Tennessee where they raised children and goats.
During the campaign, he ran on protecting Social Security, healthcare, gun rights, lower taxes on working Americans, and requiring congressional approval for wars.
He received 0.5% of the vote to Chuck Fleischmann's 57.6%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
